instruction: Indent lines 2 and 3 by two tabs in test.py.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.task_rationale: Tests indenting a smaller range (2 lines) by a larger amount (2 tabs instead of 1), requiring the agent to press Tab twice or find another method
metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting lines 2-3 and pressing Tab twice to add 8 spaces of indentation. Getter reads the file and returns all lines. Metric checks lines 2-3 match expected content with double indentation. Partial credit: 0.5 per correct line.
